title: A sale and a standing fee
hook: A toy business pays a fixed fee even when no sale arrives. Where does that cost belong?

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Include fixed costs in every outcome before computing expected net.

misconception: A fixed operating cost should be subtracted only when a sale occurs.
objective: Include fixed costs in every outcome before computing expected net.

claims.text: A toy stall receives 80 credits with 25% probability and pays a 10-credit fee regardless. Expected net? The sale net is 70 and no-sale net is −10; 0.25 × 70 + 0.75 × (−10) = 10.
